title: Keurig K-Iced Coffee Maker, Single Serve K-Cup Pod Iced Coffee Maker, With Hot and Cold Coffee Capabilities, Brews Any K-Cup Pod, Gray
reviews: Unit is easy to use, sleek, compact. Iced coffee setting brews coffee at cooler temp so ice won’t melt as quickly. 8, 10, 12 oz options are great to have. Good brew strength and brew speed.

Keurig K-Iced Coffee Maker, Single Serve is a GREAT Coffee Maker. It makes both hot and cold coffee, has a strong brew option, and a nice sized water tank in the back. The water tank reservoir size is a really nice size and you don't have to add water after every cup, like I used to with my previous Keurig coffee maker. It's also very fast and very quiet. My step-mom, and my step-sister both have the same model, and they love it too. It quickly and quietly makes your coffee and is very easy to use.I highly recommend this coffee maker.

Personally - As a busy parent, having a quick and convenient way to start the day is essential. The Keurig K-Iced Single Serve Coffee Maker has been a game-changer for our household. Design and Build Quality: The sleek gray design fits perfectly on our kitchen counter, adding a modern touch to our space. The build quality is excellent, and the machine feels sturdy and reliable. Functionality: The ability to brew both hot and cold beverages is a fantastic feature. I enjoy a hot cup of coffee in the morning, while my spouse prefers iced coffee. This Keurig caters to both our preferences effortlessly. Ease of Use: Using the K-Iced Coffee Maker is incredibly simple. The straightforward controls and quick brewing time make it perfect for our hectic mornings. We can each have our preferred coffee ready in minutes without any fuss. Performance: The coffee maker consistently delivers delicious coffee, whether hot or cold. The iced coffee feature brews directly over ice, ensuring a perfectly chilled drink without diluting the flavor. Convenience: Cleaning and maintaining the machine is hassle-free. The removable drip tray and water reservoir make it easy to keep everything clean and ready for use. Pros: Sleek and modern design Brews both hot and cold beverages Easy to use with quick brewing time Consistently great taste for both hot and iced coffee Easy to clean and maintain Cons: The water reservoir could be a bit larger for fewer refills It tends to drip after removing cleaning it and removing the K-cup (this is annoying - Thus the 4 stars for cleaning) For My Daughter starting college was a big transition, and having the convenience of a morning cup of coffee was a must (probably good for those in class with her as well) Pros: Design: The compact size fits perfectly in my dorm room, and the gray color looks sleek and stylish. It doesn’t take up much space, which is a big plus in a small room. Ease of Use:The coffee maker is super easy to use. The controls are intuitive, and it brews quickly, which is great when I’m rushing to class. It’s also easy to set up and requires minimal effort to get my coffee ready. Cons: Same as above The Keurig K-Iced Single Serve Coffee Maker has been a fantastic addition both at home and in my daughter's dorm room. It offers the convenience of brewing both hot and cold beverages quickly and easily, with consistently great taste. Whether you’re a busy parent or a college student, this coffee maker is a reliable and stylish choice to start your day right.

Love the coffee (hot and iced) that this compact coffee maker provides. Only problem was it stopped working less than a month after I received it. Keurig diagnosed as "defective". Amazon no stock to replace it (offered a refund), but Keurig offered a free replacement after sending the the documentation and photos. Takes about a week to replace through manufacturer. Can't wait to use it again! Now -- fed up!! Keurig replaced my first defective K-Ice. I received it on the 13th, and it stopped working on the 18th!!! Again, Keurig decided it was defective, and will replace it AGAIN after I send them all the photos of machine and serial number sticker, then I need to return it to them to get another free replacement. I will also need to ship this one back to them. I asked if the model was defective, and if this would just happen again -- they said that if the next one is also defective they will talk about possible other options. VERY FRUSTRATING!! Don't bother with this one unless you want to replace it over and over!
Nice compact Keurig. Very reliable and it is quieter than the older model I had. Would buy again.

This is by far the best Keurig I've purchased. Did exactly what I as the only person in my house who drinks coffee needed. Slim so it doesn't take up space, the biggest cup setting is amazing and easy to use.

I've had Keurig coffee makers since they first came out. Some have lasted years, others not so much-- as the years pass, the newer models don't last as long (one quit after only two weeks). The convenience is good, but I also like to use my own coffee, so I bought a pair of official Keurig K-Cup reusable filters. I will say that this is the worst Keurig coffee maker I've ever owned. I meant to send the thing back, but ended up traveling and returning home one day after the return period had expired. This Keurig drips, dribbles, leaks, and generally makes a huge mess. If you don't make sure that your cup is pushed all the way to the back and against the coffee maker, get ready to clean up. A half inch of space will get you photographs 1 and 2. Coffee will splatter onto the coffee maker and down the side of your cup, filling the catch basin below it. In photograph 2 you can see how the leaked coffee spreads all the way around to the side of the coffee maker. Your cup is sitting in it, so you have to put the cup on a paper towel or get coffee all over your counter or table. To make a bad situation worse, the thing is almost impossible to clean-- you can't get your fingers in there adequately. Even the reusuable filters end up a mess-- grounds everywhere as if the coffee maker full force blows hot water into it. After the coffee is finished, the coffee maker will still drip and dribble for some time. You can't turn the coffee maker off, so there are bright white-- and really irritating-- flashing lights (you can see them in photograph 2) for five minutes. If you want to stop them, your only option is to unplug the coffee maker. This Keurig coffee maker is so aggravating and messy, it makes me want to never buy a Keurig again.

So many uses, so easy to use for hot coffee. Cold Coffee, iced coffee, your teas ready to use right out of the box. After you wipe it down, do a quick rinse off. Great value, comes in many colors. Love love love. A must have highly recommended. Get one today. Easy to clean is a good fit. Water capacity is excellent. High quality has no smell.
